script.base: Spread and total were not saved, so the flow is inferred only from weeks 2-4 form. pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. Tuten finished near 52 because PHI jumped ahead — the spread we didn't have had JAX as a dog, Lawrence's clean-EPA split never mattered once the script flipped, and Rodriguez (20 carries, 85 yards already in the window) took second-half work. Hurts cleared 27.5 on two scrambles against a 26% blitz: the 19.7 average hid a spike we cannot see without game logs, and a 3.41 YPC defense still gives up the occasional QB escape. The counter-case is real because both edges are thin and spread, inactives, and game logs are missing, so these are leans not anchors. It is not stronger than the base read (PHI leaks the run, JAX does not), which is why they stay; either leg dies if its flip hits.
slip_story: One story: JAX ground control and a PHI pass funnel. Tuten rush-over and Hurts rush-under win together when PHI cannot stop the run and JAX bottles designed QB runs. Do not add JAX WR overs (Washington, Strange, Thomas) — those need the trail-and-throw flip. Do not add Wicks or Lemon overs — those need Hurts to beat a 26% blitz he has graded -0.21 against. No TD legs. Two legs only; the pack did not produce a third leg that survived the pre-mortem.
